justification: Inner West lots get their former council from the ABS 2015 former-LGA polygons instead of the nearest precinct outline; Step 9 of the lot index no longer guesses.

pre_impl.existing_data: lot_search_index.former_council, read by precinct-service getFormerCouncilForPoint for Inner West addresses
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Step 9b assumed precinct outlines tile each former council; they do not, so nearest-precinct put 1,901 lots in a neighbour's council
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: replaces the nearest-precinct fallback with containment in an official boundary; edge lots within 20 m are left unchanged

functions.name: decide
functions.input: stored council, ABS council containing the lot, depth inside it, margin
functions.output: the council to write, or None to leave the lot
functions.if_none: lot left as stored; it is counted in the edge total

values.guard_at: raises unless exactly one polygon is returned per name
values.if_missing: the run stops before any write

queries.purpose: write the ABS-derived former council for lots that disagree

break_it.scenario: lot near a former-council boundary where ABS polygons are generalised
break_it.what_happens: a correct value could be overwritten
break_it.how: lots within 20 m of the boundary are never changed

break_it.scenario: ABS service returns zero or two polygons for a name
break_it.what_happens: lots would be judged against a wrong or missing boundary

break_it.scenario: the lot index is rebuilt after this merge
break_it.what_happens: the old nearest-precinct step would reintroduce wrong councils
break_it.how: Step 9 uses the same ABS decision; a test fails if a nearest-precinct query returns

falsifiable_check.fails_when: 162/137 Victoria Street Ashfield is not assigned ashfield, or Step 9 contains a nearest-precinct query
falsifiable_check.observed_red: prod /api/property returned Marrickville for 162/137 Victoria St Ashfield on 2026-10-15 before the repair; Ashfield after
falsifiable_check.external_authority: ABS ASGS 2015 LGA polygons Ashfield (A), Leichhardt (A), Marrickville (A)

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: repair already applied 2026-10-15 20:55; re-run the dry run and expect 0 changes

real_layer_exempt.scripts/repair_former_council_from_abs.p: ran against production on 2026-10-15: dry run 1,901 changes, then --apply with backup; prod /api/property for 162/137 Victoria St Ashfield then returned Ashfield
real_layer_exempt.scripts/build_lot_search_index.py: Step 9 reuses the unit-tested decide() and the same ABS SQL as the repair script that ran on production; the full index rebuild itself has NOT been run against production with this change, recorded here as an open gap
